{"claims":[{"claim_text":"As president, Trump failed to mount an effective and coherent strategy to prevent overdoses.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Opioid-related deaths spiked under Trump's presidency.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"If Trump is allowed back in the White House, many Americans who struggle with addiction will lose critical, life-saving health care.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The pandemic exacerbated feelings of sadness, isolation, and loneliness across the country.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The pandemic strained the health care system, including mental health services.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe mental health care is health care.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"In 2020, less than half of all adults with a mental illness diagnosis received care for it.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Nearly 70 percent of children who need mental health care cannot get it.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Democrats are taking steps to dramatically expand access to mental health care in America.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The Administration launched 988, the National Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, which has connected nearly 10 million Americans in crisis to immediate, confidential, and free support from trained counselors.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"The National Maternal Mental Health Hotline has received more than 30,000 calls and texts to help mothers and their loved ones navigate mental health issues.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will push to expand 988 to handle increased capacity and serve more Americans.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
